source.description: the code itself (at most 256 KiB), e.g. what file_read returned

symbol.description: a name (`push`) or a path of enclosing definitions, joined by `.` or `::` (`Stack.push`)

text.description: also return each definition's full text; default false

firstLine.description: line number of the source's first line, when it is a range read with file_read `lines`; default 1
